name: velvet
design: An adult woman with a distinctive low contralto voice and a neutral American English accent. Close, dry studio recording. Smooth dark timbre with a faint husky edge, steady and self-possessed. Speak conversationally with precise consonants, relaxed pacing, narrow pitch movement, and understated warmth. No theatrical acting, no whispering, no exaggerated breathiness.
text: I'm Aura. We can take a moment. Tell me what you're thinking, and we'll work through it together. There is no need to rush. I'd rather get it right.
